verdict.rationale: Inngest offers a REST API (inngest-docs-7), and its TypeScript SDK reference is published under a versioned path ('/reference/typescript/v4/'), which suggests some versioning of the developer-facing interfaces (inngest-docs-14). The versioning doc (inngest-docs-19) covers deploying function changes, not API versioning. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy or a versioning scheme for the REST API. Missing for 10: explicit REST API versioning documentation, a documented deprecation policy or timeline, and changelog evidence of deprecation notices.
